Problem Statement:
Given a string S of length N, rearrange the letters in the string to form a new string X which is lexicographically greater than current string(If many answers are possible, output lexicographically smallest one). If no string exists print '-1'.
input_spec: The input consists of a string S of length N, where 1 <= N <= 100000.
output_spec:
lexicographically smallest one). If no string exists print '-1'.

Input Description:
The input consists of a string S of length N, where 1 <= N <= 100000.

Output Description:
The output is the lexicographically smallest string X that is greater than S, or '-1' if no such string exists.
